" alt="ふーぴょんときゅうしょくしつのひみつ"><span class="v26-version v27-version">Ver.3.25</span></div>
  <nav class="v26-tabs" aria-label="エリアを選ぶ">${[['衛生','えいせい','front'],['準備','じゅんび','prep'],['調理','ちょうり','cook'],['片付け','かたづけ','wash']].map((t,i)=>`<button type="button" data-v26-zone="${t[2]}" class="${i===0?'current':''}">${v26Kanji(t[0],t[1])}</button>`).join('')}</nav>
 </header>
 <div class="v26-board-scroller" id="v26-board-scroller" aria-label="給食室マップ。設備を選ぶとゲームが始まります"><div class="v26-room-grid" id="v26-room-grid">${V26_ROOMS.map(v26Room).join('')}</div></div>
 <nav class="v26-bottom" aria-label="ゲームメニュー"><div class="v26-stats"><span>${v26Kanji('設備','せつび')} <b id="v26-stat-completed">${state.completed.length}</b> / 12</span><span>${v26Kanji('コイン','こいん')} <b id="v26-stat-coins">${coins()}</b></span><span>${v26Kanji('秘密','ひみつ')} <b id="v26-stat-secrets">${state.secrets.length}</b> / 4</span></div><div class="v26-menu-buttons">
 ${[['cards','カードファイル','カードファイル'],['save','保存','ほぞん'],['zoom','ズーム表示','ズーム'],['crew','キャラ変更','キャラへんこう'],['rooms','部屋の区分','へやのくぶん'],['help','遊び方','あそびかた'],['lang',state.reading==='kana'?'漢字に切替':'ひらがなに切替',state.reading==='kana'?'かんじにきりかえ':'ひらがなにきりかえ'],['home','タイトルに戻る','タイトルにもどる'],['reset','リセット','リセット']].map(([key,kanji,kana])=>`<button type="button" data-v26-action="${key}" class="${key==='reset'?'v26-reset':''}">${v26Kanji(kanji,kana)}</button>`).join('')}
 </div><button type="button" class="v26-mobile-menu-trigger" id="v26-mobile-menu-trigger">メニュー</button></nav>
 </div>`;}
function v26RenderBoard(){const host=$('v26-room-grid');if(!host)return;const oldScroll=$('v26-board-scroller').scrollLeft;host.innerHTML=V26_ROOMS.map(v26Room).join('');$('v26-board-scroller').scrollLeft=oldScroll;
 host.querySelectorAll('[data-v26-device]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{v26Sound('tap');openMission(+b.dataset.v26Device)}));
 host.querySelectorAll('[data-v26-secret]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{v26Sound('tap');openSecretChallenge(+b.dataset.v26Secret);}));}
function v26Update(){
 const host=$('v26-room-grid');
 if(host){
  if(host.querySelectorAll('[data-v26-device]').length!==DEVICES.length){v26RenderBoard()}
  // Update ONLY changed state. Rebuilding the room DOM on every HUD tick
  // made images reload and reset gamepad focus/scroll.
  host.querySelectorAll('[data-v26-device]').forEach(b=>{
   const done=state.completed.includes(Number(b.dataset.v26Device));
   b.classList.toggle('is-done',done);
   const mark=b.querySelector('.v26-check');
   if(done&&!mark){b.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span class="v26-check" aria-label="クリア済み">✓</span>')}
   if(!done&&mark)mark.remove();
  });
  host.querySelectorAll('[data-v26-secret]').forEach(b=>{
   const done=state.secrets.includes(Number(b.dataset.v26Secret));
   b.classList.toggle('found',done);
   const mark=b.querySelector('.v37-secret-done,.v31-tome-done');
   if(done&&!mark){b.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span class="v37-secret-done" aria-label="発見済み">✓</span>')}
   if(!done&&mark)mark.remove();
  });
 }
 for(const [id,v] of [['v26-stat-completed',state.completed.length],['v26-stat-coins',coins()],['v26-stat-secrets',state.secrets.length]]){
  const el=$(id);if(el&&el.textContent!==String(v))el.textContent=String(v);
 }
}
const v26OriginalToast=showToast;
showToast=function(t){if(/設備をタップして秘密|せつびを タップして ひみつ/.test(t))return;v26OriginalToast(t);};
const v26OriginalHud=updateHud;
updateHud=function(){v26OriginalHud(); if($('v26-room-grid'))v26Update();};
function v26Actions(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-v26-action]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{v26Sound('tap');const id=b.dataset.v26Action;if(modalKind==='v26menu' && !['cards','rooms','help','reset'].includes(id))closeModal();
 switch(id){
 case 'cards':openGuide();break; case 'save':save(true);break;
 case 'zoom':$('v26-board-scroller').classList.toggle('enlarged');b.textContent=$('v26-board-scroller').classList.contains('enlarged')?'全体表示':'ズーム表示';break;
 case 'crew':enterChoose();break;case 'rooms':openSanitaryRooms();break;case 'help':openHelp();break;
 case 'lang':state.reading=state.reading==='kana'?'kanji':'kana';save();applyReadingMode();v26RefreshUI();break;
 case 'home':showScreen('home');break;case 'reset':v26ConfirmReset();break;
 }});
 const trigger=$('v26-mobile-menu-trigger');if(trigger)trigger.onclick=v26OpenMobileMenu;
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-v26-zone]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-v26-zone]').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('current'));b.classList.add('current');const room=document.querySelector('.v26-'+b.dataset.v26Zone);if(room){room.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest',inline:'center'});if(room.animate)room.animate([{filter:'brightness(1.16)'},{filter:'brightness(1)'}],{duration:600});}});
}
function v26OpenMobileMenu(){const html=`<div class="v26-menu-grid">${Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.v26-menu-buttons [data-v26-action]')).map(b=>`<button type="button" data-v26-action="${b.dataset.v26Action}">${v26E(b.textContent)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;openModal('v26menu','メニュー',html);v26Actions();}
function v26RefreshUI(){const stage=document.querySelector('.v26-stage');if(!stage)return;stage.outerHTML=v26Html();v26Actions();v26RenderBoard();}
const v26OriginalShowScreen=showScreen;
showScreen=function(id){v26OriginalShowScreen(id);if(id==='play'){v26RefreshUI();} if(id==='end'){v26RenderEnding();}};
function v26ConfirmReset(){const body=`<div class="v26-reset-confirm"><h2>冒険の記録をリセットしますか？</h2><p>設備12件、コイン、秘密、獲得カードが最初からになります。操作は取り消せません。</p><div class="v26-reset-row"><button type="button" id="v26-reset-cancel" class="altBtn">キャンセル</button><button type="button" id="v26-reset-execute" class="v26-danger">記録をリセット</button></div></div>`;
 openModal('reset','データのリセット',body);
 $('v26-reset-cancel').onclick=closeModal;
 $('v26-reset-execute').onclick=()=>{v26StopGame();dismissCardCapture();try{localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY)}catch(e){}state.completed=[];state.secrets=[];state.px=99;state.py=401;state.bonus=false;hasSave=false;closeModal();updateHud();showScreen('home');showToast('冒険の記録をリセットしました');};
}
function v26RenderEnding(){const end=$('end');if(!end)return;
 const fullySecrets=state.secrets.length===4;const title=v26Kanji('12個の設備 完全クリア！','12この せつび かんぜんクリア！');
 end.innerHTML=`<div class="v26-end-photo"><img class="v26-ending-art" src="${ENDING_ILLUSTRATION}" alt="給食室でみんながお祝いしている公式イラスト"><div class="v26-end-overlay"><div class="v26-end-badge">${v26Kanji('これで君は給食室マスター！','これで きみは きゅうしょくしつ マスター！')}</div><h1>${title}</h1><p>${fullySecrets?v26Kanji('設備も秘密もコンプリート！','せつびも ひみつも コンプリート！'):v26Kanji('12個の設備を発見したね！秘密の探索も楽しめるよ。','12この せつびを みつけたよ！ひみつも さがしてみよう。')}</p><div class="v26-end-stats"><span>設備 12 / 12</span><span>コイン ${coins()}</span><span>秘密 ${state.secrets.length} / 4</span></div><div class="v26-end-buttons"><button type="button" id="v26-end-explore">${v26Kanji('探索に戻る','たんけんにもどる')}</button><button type="button" id="v26-end-cards">カードファイル</button><button type="button" id="v26-end-home">${v26Kanji('タイトルに戻る','タイトルにもどる')}</button><button type="button" id="v26-end-reset" class="v26-danger">リセット</button></div></div></div><div class="v26-ending-particles" id="v26-ending-particles"></div>`;
 $('v26-end-cards').onclick=()=>openGuide(4);$('v26-end-home').onclick=()=>showScreen('home');$('v26-end-explore').onclick=()=>showScreen('play');$('v26-end-reset').onclick=v26ConfirmReset;
 end.style.setProperty('--v26-ending',`url("${ENDING_ILLUSTRATION}")`);v26Confetti(true);v26Sound('win');}
const v26OriginalEnding=showEnding;
showEnding=function(){dismissCardCapture();v26StopGame();showScreen('end');};
function v26Confetti(end=false){const holder=end?$('v26-ending-particles'):$('v26-confetti');if(!holder)return;holder.replaceChildren();const color=['#ffc456','#5cd4d2','#fa84af','#aa8fe9','#73d38d','#fff'];for(let i=0;i<76;i++){const b=document.createElement('i');b.style.setProperty('--x',Math.random()*100+'%');b.style.setProperty('--d',(2+Math.random()*2.1)+'s');b.style.setProperty('--delay',Math.random()*.8+'s');b.style.setProperty('--c',color[i%color.length]);holder.appendChild(b)}setTimeout(()=>{if(holder.isConnected)holder.replaceChildren()},4400);}
let v26Audio=null;
function v26Sound(type='tap'){try{const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC)return;if(!v26Audio)v26Audio=new AC();if(v26Audio.state==='suspended')v26Audio.resume();const notes=type==='win'?[523,659,784,1046]:type==='bonus'?[440,660,880]:type==='success'?[550,820]:[360];notes.forEach((hz,i)=>{const osc=v26Audio.createOscillator(),gain=v26Audio.createGain();osc.type='sine';osc.frequency.value=hz;const t=v26Audio.currentTime+i*.105;gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(type==='tap'?.012:.045,t+.018);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+.14);osc.connect(gain);gain.connect(v26Audio.destination);osc.start(t);osc.stop(t+.15)});}catch(e){}}
let v26Timers=[],v26Wash=null,v26Bug=null,v26Rapid=null;
function v26StopGame(){v26Timers.forEach(x=>clearInterval(x));v26Timers=[];v26Wash=null;v26Bug=null;v26Rapid=null;}
const v26OriginalClose=closeModal;
closeModal=function(){v26StopGame();dismissCardCapture();v26OriginalClose();};
const v26OriginalOpenMission=openMission;
openMission=function(id){v26StopGame();dismissCardCapture();v26OriginalOpenMission(id);};
const v26OriginalCapture=launchCardCapture;
launchCardCapture=function(d){if(!$('play').classList.contains('active') || modalKind!=='mission' || phase!=='won')return;v26OriginalCapture(d);};
const v26OriginalRenderChallenge=renderChallenge;
renderChallenge=function(){const d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===activeId);if(!d || ![1,2,8].includes(d.id))return v26OriginalRenderChallenge();v26StopGame();
 let body='';
 if(d.id===1)body=v26WashHtml();
 if(d.id===2)body=v26BugHtml();
 if(d.id===8)body=v26RapidHtml(d);
 $('modalBody').innerHTML=body+'<div id="challengeFeedback" class="v26-game-feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div><div class="modalActions"><button class="altBtn" id="backIntro">説明へ戻る</button></div>';
 syncModalFooter();$('backIntro').onclick=()=>openMission(activeId);
 if(d.id===1)v26BindWash();if(d.id===2)v26BindBug();if(d.id===8)v26BindRapid(d);
};
function v26WashHtml(){return `<div class="v26-mini v26-wash"><div class="v26-mini-label">HAND WASH CHALLENGE</div><h2>あわ100％をめざして手を洗おう！</h2><p>「はじめるよ」を押して、せっけんの泡を100％まで増やそう。100％になったらすぐにクリア！</p><div class="v26-wash-layout"><div class="v26-wash-visual"><img src="${EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[1]}" alt="手洗いシンク"><div class="v26-wash-bubbles" id="v26-wash-bubbles"></div></div><div class="v26-wash-work"><div class="v26-mini-stats"><span>泡 <b id="v26-wash-foam">0</b>%</span><span>経過 <b id="v26-wash-seconds">0.0</b>秒</span></div><div class="v26-mini-meter"><i id="v26-wash-meter"></i></div><button type="button" id="v26-wash-start" class="v26-game-main">はじめるよ</button><button type="button" id="v26-wash-scrub" class="v26-scrub" hidden>ここをこすって泡をつくろう</button><p id="v26-wash-message" class="v26-mini-message">準備ができたらスタート！</p></div></div></div>`;}
function v26BindWash(){const start=$('v26-wash-start'),scrub=$('v26-wash-scrub'),foam=$('v26-wash-foam'),secs=$('v26-wash-seconds'),meter=$('v26-wash-meter'),msg=$('v26-wash-message');
 start.onclick=()=>{v26Sound('success');start.hidden=true;scrub.hidden=false;v26Wash={start:performance.now(),foam:0,done:false,points:0};msg.textContent='タップやドラッグで手をこすろう！';const tick=setInterval(()=>{if(!v26Wash)return;const delta=(performance.now()-v26Wash.start)/1000;secs.textContent=delta.toFixed(1);if(v26Wash.foam>=100&&!v26Wash.done){v26Wash.done=true;v26StopGame();winMission();}},100);v26Timers.push(tick);};
 let lastMove=0;
 const apply=(amount)=>{if(!v26Wash||v26Wash.done)return;v26Wash.foam=Math.min(100,v26Wash.foam+amount);foam.textContent=Math.round(v26Wash.foam);meter.style.width=v26Wash.foam+'%';scrub.style.background=`linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(97,208,235,${.2+v26Wash.foam/200}),rgba(241,255,255,.95))`;const b=$('v26-wash-bubbles');if(b&&b.children.length<22){const e=document.createElement('i');e.style.left=Math.random()*85+'%';e.style.top=Math.random()*75+'%';e.style.width=(9+Math.random()*17)+'px';e.style.height=e.style.width;b.appendChild(e);}if(v26Wash.foam>=100&&!v26Wash.done){v26Wash.done=true;v26StopGame();winMission();}};
 scrub.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{scrub.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);apply(6);});
 scrub.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(e.buttons && performance.now()-lastMove>38){lastMove=performance.now();apply(2.5);}});
 scrub.addEventListener('click',()=>apply(5));
}
function v26BugHtml(){return `<div class="v26-mini v26-bugs"><div class="v26-mini-label">VEGETABLE INSPECTION</div><h2>三層シンクの虫を探そう！</h2><p>野菜にかくれた虫を3つ見つけよう。1つ見つけるごとに次の槽へ進むよ。</p><div class="v26-bug-stats"><strong id="v26-bug-round">第1槽 / 3</strong><span id="v26-bug-found">発見 0 / 3</span></div><div class="v26-bug-tray" id="v26-bug-tray" aria-label="野菜を調べる画面"></div><p class="v26-mini-message" id="v26-bug-message">緑の野菜をよく見てタップしてね。</p></div>`;}
const V26_BUG_POS=[{x:73,y:43},{x:21,y:63},{x:58,y:27}];
function v26PaintBug(){const n=v26Bug.round;const tray=$('v26-bug-tray');if(!tray||!v26Bug)return;const pos=V26_BUG_POS[n];const leafs=Array.from({length:19},(_,i)=>{const x=8+(i*37%87),y=15+(i*59%72),rot=(i*43)%180;return `<i class="v26-leaf" style="left:${x}%;top:${y}%;transform:rotate(${rot}deg) scale(${.8+(i%4)*.13})"></i>`;}).join('');
 tray.innerHTML=`<div class="v26-tray-label">${n+1}そう目・野菜チェック</div>${leafs}<button type="button" id="v26-the-bug" class="v26-the-bug" style="left:${pos.x}%;top:${pos.y}%" aria-label="虫を発見"><span class="v26-bug-body"></span></button>`;
 $('v26-the-bug').onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();v26Sound('success');v26Bug.round++;$('v26-bug-found').textContent=`発見 ${v26Bug.round} / 3`;
 if(v26Bug.round>=3){v26StopGame();winMission();return;}
 $('v26-bug-round').textContent=`第${v26Bug.round+1}槽 / 3`;$('v26-bug-message').textContent='見つけた！次の槽も点検しよう。';v26PaintBug();};
}
function v26BindBug(){v26Bug={round:0,miss:0};v26PaintBug();$('v26-bug-tray').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('#v26-the-bug'))return;v26Bug.miss++;$('v26-bug-message').textContent=v26Bug.miss%3===0?'ヒント：小さな黒い虫が葉っぱにいるよ。':'惜しい！葉っぱの間をよく見てね。';});}
function v26RapidHtml(d){return `<div class="v26-mini v26-rapid"><div class="v26-mini-label">KETTLE MIXING</div><h2>大きな回転釜でまぜよう！</h2><p>「はじめるよ」から8秒以内に22回タップ！ すばやくまぜて完成をめざそう。</p><div class="v26-rapid-layout"><img src="${EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[8]}" alt="回転釜"><div><div class="v26-mini-stats"><span>回数 <b id="v26-rapid-count">0</b> / 22</span><span>残り <b id="v26-rapid-time">8.0</b>秒</span></div><div class="v26-mini-meter"><i id="v26-rapid-fill"></i></div><button type="button" class="v26-game-main" id="v26-rapid-start">はじめるよ</button><button type="button" class="v26-game-main" id="v26-rapid-tap" hidden>まぜる！</button><p class="v26-mini-message" id="v26-rapid-message">準備ができたらスタート！</p></div></div></div>`;}
function v26BindRapid(d){const start=$('v26-rapid-start'),tap=$('v26-rapid-tap'),time=$('v26-rapid-time'),count=$('v26-rapid-count'),meter=$('v26-rapid-fill'),msg=$('v26-rapid-message');
 const begin=()=>{v26StopGame();v26Rapid={start:performance.now(),hits:0};start.hidden=true;tap.hidden=false;count.textContent='0';meter.style.width='0%';msg.textContent='テンポよくタップ！';v26Sound('success');const tick=setInterval(()=>{if(!v26Rapid)return;const left=8-(performance.now()-v26Rapid.start)/1000;time.textContent=Math.max(0,left).toFixed(1);if(left<=0){v26StopGame();tap.hidden=true;start.hidden=false;start.textContent='もう一度挑戦';msg.textContent='時間切れ！もう一度挑戦してみよう。';}},70);v26Timers.push(tick);};
 start.onclick=begin;tap.onclick=()=>{if(!v26Rapid)return;v26Rapid.hits++;count.textContent=v26Rapid.hits;meter.style.width=Math.min(100,v26Rapid.hits/22*100)+'%';if(v26Rapid.hits%5===0)v26Sound('tap');if(v26Rapid.hits>=22){v26StopGame();winMission();}};
}
const v26OldWin=winMission;
winMission=function(){v26StopGame();const newCard=!state.completed.includes(activeId);v26OldWin();if($('doneMission'))$('doneMission').textContent=state.completed.length===12?'完全クリアへ':'マップに戻る';if($('missionGuide'))$('missionGuide').textContent='カードファイル';const r=$('modalBody').querySelector('.reward');if(r)r.textContent=newCard?(state.completed.length===12?'＋30 コイン獲得！':'＋10 コイン獲得！'):'クリア済みの設備';v26Sound('bonus');v26Confetti();v26Update();};
// Rebuild with existing bundled image assets; no network access is needed.
const v26Play=$('play'); if(v26Play){const older=v26Play.querySelector('.v26-stage');if(older)older.remove();v26Play.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',v26Html());v26Play.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<div class="v26-confetti-layer" id="v26-confetti" aria-hidden="true"></div>');v26Actions();v26RenderBoard();}


/* Ver.2.8 — image-perfect assets and cinematic card capture */
const v27CaptureTimers=[];
function v27CleanCapture(){
 while(v27CaptureTimers.length)clearTimeout(v27CaptureTimers.pop());
 clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer);clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer2);
 const root=$('cardCaptureOverlay');if(root){root.classList.remove('visible','collected','animate','v27-capture');root.replaceChildren();}
}
dismissCardCapture=v27CleanCapture;
launchCardCapture=function(d){
 v27CleanCapture();
 if(!d || !STAR_CARD_IMAGES[d.id])return;
 const host=$('cardCaptureOverlay');
 const stars=Array.from({length:18},(_,i)=>{
  const x=6+((i*37+11)%88),y=12+((i*31+7)%72),dur=1.3+(i%6)*.26,delay=(i%5)*-.26;
  return `<i class="v27-star" style="--x:${x}%;--y:${y}%;--dur:${dur}s;--delay:${delay}s"></i>`;
 }).join('');
 host.classList.add('v27-capture');
 host.innerHTML=`<div class="v27-capture-scene"><div class="v27-light-rays" aria-hidden="true"></div>${stars}<div class="v27-capture-heading">スターカード GET！<small>No.${String(d.id).padStart(2,'0')}　${d.name}</small></div><div class="v27-capture-front">${starCardArt(d)}</div><div class="v27-capture-binder" aria-label="カードファイル"></div><div class="v27-capture-binder-label">カードファイルへ収納</div><div class="v27-capture-footer"><span id="v27-capture-message">カードを大きく表示中</span><button class="v27-capture-skip" type="button" id="v27-capture-skip">演出をスキップ</button></div></div>`;
 $('v27-capture-skip').onclick=v27CleanCapture;
 host.classList.add('visible');
 v27CaptureTimers.push(setTimeout(()=>{
  if(!host.classList.contains('visible'))return;
  host.classList.add('collected');
  const msg=$('v27-capture-message');if(msg)msg.textContent='カードファイルに収納！';
 },1750));
 v27CaptureTimers.push(setTimeout(()=>{
  v27CleanCapture();
 },3400));
};
const v27CloseModal=closeModal;
closeModal=function(){v27CleanCapture();v27CloseModal();};
const v27OldShowScreen=showScreen;
showScreen=function(id){ if(id==='home'||id==='choose'||id==='end')v27CleanCapture();v27OldShowScreen(id); };

/* Ver.2.8 | SCHOOL LUNCH COOK mini-game mechanics and single-page card book */
const V28_HAND='data:image/webp;base64,';
const V28_LEAF='data:image/webp;base64,';
const V28_SINK_FRAME='data:image/webp;base64,';
let v28Game=null;
let v28Timers=[];
function v28Timer(cb,delay){const id=setTimeout(cb,delay);v28Timers.push(id);return id;}
function v28Clear(){
 if(v28Game?.raf)cancelAnimationFrame(v28Game.raf);
 v28Timers.forEach(clearTimeout);v28Timers=[];
 if(v28Game?.keyHandler){document.removeEventListener('keydown',v28Game.keyHandler);document.removeEventListener('keyup',v28Game.keyUpHandler);}
 v28Game=null;
}
const v28PriorStop=v26StopGame;
v26StopGame=function(){v28Clear();v28PriorStop();};

function v28OpenMini(){
 const d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===activeId);if(!d)return;
 if(d.id===1){v28HandHTML();v28HandBind();}
 else if(d.id===2){v28SinkHTML();v28SinkBind();}
 else if(d.id===4){v28TimingHTML();v28TimingBind();}
}
const v28PreviousChallenge=renderChallenge;
renderChallenge=function(){
 const d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===activeId);
 if(d && [1,2,4].includes(d.id)){
  v26StopGame(); v28OpenMini();
 }else v28PreviousChallenge();
};
function v28Frame(content){
 $('modalBody').innerHTML=`<div class="v28-mini">${content}</div><div class="modalActions v28-modal-bottom"><button type="button" class="altBtn" id="v28-back">説明へ戻る</button></div>`;
 syncModalFooter();$('v28-back').onclick=()=>openMission(activeId);
}
function v28HandHTML(){
 v28Frame(`<div class="v28-mini-head"><span>SCHOOL LUNCH COOK・手洗い</span><h2>あわあわ！手洗い大作戦</h2><p>「はじめるよ」の後、手のイラストを指やマウスでなぞって泡を100％にしよう。100％になったらクリア！</p></div>
 <div class="v28-hand-layout"><div class="v28-hand-box" id="v28-hand-box"><img src="${V28_HAND}" id="v28-hand-image" alt="SCHOOL LUNCH COOKで使う手洗いの手のイラスト"><canvas id="v28-hand-canvas" width="560" height="517" aria-label="泡を塗る手のイラスト"></canvas></div>
 <div class="v28-mini-right"><div class="v28-ticks"><strong>泡 <b id="v28-hand-percent">0</b>％</strong><strong>時間 <b id="v28-hand-time">0.0</b>秒</strong></div><div class="v28-meter"><i id="v28-hand-fill"></i></div><button type="button" class="v28-hero-button" id="v28-hand-start">はじめるよ</button><p class="v28-caption" id="v28-hand-status">手のひら・指先・親指まで泡で包もう！</p><div class="v28-hand-keyguide">PC：ドラッグ／矢印キー＋スペース　スマホ：指でなぞる</div></div></div>`);
}
function v28HandBind(){
 const g=v28Game={mode:'hand',start:0,percent:0,active:false,down:false,covered:new Set(),mask:null,total:0,posX:280,posY:260,keys:new Set(),raf:0};
 const box=$('v28-hand-box'),canvas=$('v28-hand-canvas'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
 const image=$('v28-hand-image'),start=$('v28-hand-start');
 let loaded=false;
 function prepareMask(){if(loaded||!image.complete||!image.naturalWidth)return;let off=document.createElement('canvas');off.width=56;off.height=52;let oc=off.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});oc.drawImage(image,0,0,56,52);let data=oc.getImageData(0,0,56,52).data;g.mask=[];for(let y=0;y<52;y++)for(let x=0;x<56;x++){if(data[(y*56+x)*4+3]>60){g.mask.push([x,y]);}}g.total=g.mask.length;loaded=true;}
 if(image.complete)prepareMask();else image.onload=prepareMask;
 function point(ev){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();return {x:Math.max(0,Math.min(559,(ev.clientX-r.left)/r.width*560)),y:Math.max(0,Math.min(516,(ev.clientY-r.top)/r.height*517))};}
 function dab(x,y){if(!g.active||v28Game!==g)return;g.posX=x;g.posY=y;if(!loaded)prepareMask();if(!g.total)return;
  const radius=91;const r2=radius*radius;
  for(const [ix,iy] of g.mask){const dx=ix*10+5-x,dy=iy*10+5-y;if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=r2)g.covered.add(iy*56+ix);}
  const pct=Math.min(100,Math.floor(100*g.covered.size/g.total));g.percent=pct;
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.83;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(232,255,255,.85)';ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,221,242,.80)';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.shadowColor='#8fe9ff';ctx.shadowBlur=12;
  for(let k=0;k<11;k++){const a=k*2.39996,dist=(k%4)*12,rr=22+(k%3)*13;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+Math.cos(a)*dist,y+Math.sin(a)*dist,rr,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();if(k%2===0)ctx.stroke();}ctx.restore();
  $('v28-hand-percent').textContent=pct;$('v28-hand-fill').style.width=pct+'%';
  if(pct===100)$('v28-hand-status').textContent='泡100％！ 10秒まで手を洗い続けよう！';
 }
 function move(e){if(g.down){e.preventDefault();const p=point(e);dab(p.x,p.y)}}
 canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(!g.active)return;e.preventDefault();g.down=true;canvas.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);const p=point(e);dab(p.x,p.y)});
 canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',move);['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'].forEach(k=>canvas.addEventListener(k,()=>{g.down=false}));
 g.keyHandler=e=>{if(v28Game!==g||!g.active)return;if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Space','KeyE'].includes(e.code)){e.preventDefault();g.keys.add(e.code)}};
 g.keyUpHandler=e=>g.keys.delete(e.code);
 document.addEventListener('keydown',g.keyHandler);document.addEventListener('keyup',g.keyUpHandler);
 function tick(t){if(v28Game!==g||!g.active)return;
  const sec=(t-g.start)/1000;$('v28-hand-time').textContent=sec.toFixed(1);
  let x=0,y=0;if(g.keys.has('ArrowLeft'))x--;if(g.keys.has('ArrowRight'))x++;if(g.keys.has('ArrowUp'))y--;if(g.keys.has('ArrowDown'))y++;
  if(x||y){g.posX=Math.max(0,Math.min(559,g.posX+x*7));g.posY=Math.max(0,Math.min(516,g.posY+y*7));}
  if(g.keys.has('Space')||g.keys.has('KeyE'))dab(g.posX,g.posY);
  if(sec>=10&&g.percent===100){v26StopGame();winMission();return;}
  if(sec>=10&&g.percent<100)$('v28-hand-status').textContent='あと少し！ 泡が100％になるまで続けよう。';
  g.raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
 }
 start.onclick=()=>{if(g.active)return;prepareMask();g.active=true;g.start=performance.now();start.hidden=true;v26Sound('success');$('v28-hand-status').textContent='手をなぞって泡を広げてね！';g.raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);};
}
function v28SinkHTML(){
 v28Frame(`<div class="v28-mini-head"><span>SCHOOL LUNCH COOK・野菜の点検</span><h2>やさいあらい・羽虫チェック</h2><p>羽虫がついた葉を覚えよう。野菜が入れ替わった後に正しいものを選んでね。</p></div>
 <div class="v28-sink-layout"><div class="v28-sink-art"><img src="${V28_SINK_FRAME}" alt="SCHOOL LUNCH COOKの野菜洗いイラスト"><strong>三層シンクで野菜の点検</strong></div>
 <div class="v28-sink-game"><div class="v28-sink-phase" id="v28-sink-phase">準備ができたら「はじめるよ」</div><div class="v28-sink-cards" id="v28-sink-cards"></div><div class="v28-sink-feedback" id="v28-sink-feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite">羽虫がいたのはどの葉？</div><div class="v28-sink-actions"><button type="button" class="v28-hero-button" id="v28-sink-start">はじめるよ</button><button type="button" class="v28-hero-button" id="v28-sink-continue" hidden>次へ進む</button></div></div></div><p class="v28-educational-note">実際の給食室では、異物の混入を防ぐために葉の裏まで確認し、定められた手順で洗います。</p>`);
}
function v28SinkBind(){
 const g=v28Game={mode:'sink',phase:'ready',order:[0,1,2],bug:1,turn:0,points:0};
 const container=$('v28-sink-cards'),start=$('v28-sink-start'),go=$('v28-sink-continue');
 function paint(){if(v28Game!==g)return;
  container.innerHTML=g.order.map((id,slot)=>`<button type="button" class="v28-veggie ${['ready','preview','result'].includes(g.phase)&&id===g.bug?'v28-has-bug':''}" data-veggie-id="${id}" ${g.phase==='choose'?'':'disabled'} aria-label="${slot+1}番の野菜"><img src="${V28_LEAF}" alt="小松菜の葉"><span class="v28-bug-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 64 64"><ellipse cx="32" cy="36" rx="8" ry="13" fill="#3b3232"/><circle cx="32" cy="20" r="6" fill="#292323"/><ellipse cx="22" cy="22" rx="9" ry="11" fill="#dcf5ff" stroke="#76b5d0" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(-25 22 22)"/><ellipse cx="42" cy="22" rx="9" ry="11" fill="#dcf5ff" stroke="#76b5d0" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(25 42 22)"/></svg></span><small>${slot+1}</small></button>`).join('');
  container.querySelectorAll('.v28-veggie').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>choose(Number(b.dataset.veggieId)));
 }
 function phase(msg){$('v28-sink-phase').textContent=msg;paint();}
 function begin(){if(v28Game!==g)return;g.order=[0,1,2];g.bug=Math.floor(Math.random()*3);g.phase='preview';g.turn=0;go.hidden=true;start.hidden=true;phase('覚えてね！ 羽虫がいる葉はどれ？');$('v28-sink-feedback').textContent='最初に羽虫のついた葉を覚えてね。';v26Sound('tap');v28Timer(()=>shuffle(),1700);}
 function shuffle(){if(v28Game!==g)return;g.phase='shuffle';let count=0;phase('野菜が入れ替わるよ！ 追いかけよう。');
  const run=()=>{if(v28Game!==g)return;const a=Math.floor(Math.random()*3);const b=(a+1+Math.floor(Math.random()*2))%3;[g.order[a],g.order[b]]=[g.order[b],g.order[a]];count++;paint();if(count<5)v28Timer(run,460);else v28Timer(()=>{if(v28Game!==g)return;g.phase='choose';phase('羽虫がいたのはどの葉？ タップして答えよう！');$('v28-sink-feedback').textContent='3枚のうち1枚を選んでね。';},490);};v28Timer(run,360);
 }
 function choose(id){if(v28Game!==g||g.phase!=='choose')return;const good=id===g.bug;g.phase='result';phase(good?'正解！':'おしい！ 正しい葉が光っているよ。');$('v28-sink-feedback').textContent=good?'よく見つけたね！ クリアしてカードを手に入れよう。':'実際は異物を見逃さないことが大切。次に進んで復習しよう。';go.hidden=false;v26Sound(good?'success':'tap');}
 start.onclick=begin;go.onclick=()=>{if(g.phase==='result'){v26StopGame();winMission();}};paint();
}

 v28Frame(`<div class="v28-mini-head"><span>SCHOOL LUNCH COOK・愛情タイミング</span><h2>スライサー・タイミングチャレンジ</h2><p>動く針を中央で止めよう！ 3回チャレンジしたらクリア。タイミングがずれても、次へ進めるよ。</p></div>

}
function v28TimingBind(){
 const g=v28Game={mode:'love',active:false,start:0,hits:0,raf:0,period:2400,roundGrades:[],roundScore:0};
 const needle=$('v28-love-needle'),status=$('v28-love-score'),start=$('v28-love-start'),stop=$('v28-love-stop'),done=$('v28-love-complete');
 const pos=(t)=>{const x=(((t-g.start)%g.period)+g.period)%g.period/g.period;return x<.5?x*2:(1-x)*2;};
 function tick(){if(v28Game!==g||!g.active)return;needle.style.left=(pos(performance.now())*100)+'%';g.raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);}
 function showNext(){if(v28Game!==g)return;g.active=true;g.start=performance.now();g.raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);stop.hidden=false;}
 start.onclick=()=>{start.hidden=true;showNext();v26Sound('success');};
 stop.onclick=()=>{if(v28Game!==g||!g.active)return;
  const x=pos(performance.now()),diff=Math.abs(x-.5),grade=diff<=.065?'PERFECT':diff<=.19?'GOOD':'NICE';
  g.active=false;cancelAnimationFrame(g.raf);needle.style.left=(x*100)+'%';stop.hidden=true;g.hits++;g.roundGrades.push(grade);g.roundScore += grade==='PERFECT'?300:grade==='GOOD'?150:30;
  $('v28-love-count').textContent=g.hits+' / 3 回';status.textContent=grade;
  $('v28-love-message').textContent=grade+'！ '+(grade==='PERFECT'?'最高のタイミング！':grade==='GOOD'?'よくできた！':'挑戦したことが大切！');
  v26Sound('success');
  if(g.hits>=3){done.hidden=false;$('v28-love-message').textContent+='　3回成功！ 次へ進めるよ。';}
  else v28Timer(()=>{if(v28Game!==g)return;status.textContent='READY';showNext();},750);
 };
 done.onclick=()=>{v26StopGame();winMission();};
 // Keyboard is an alternative; check the same timestamp-based hit judgment.
 g.keyHandler=e=>{if(v28Game===g&&g.active&&['Space','KeyE','Enter'].includes(e.code)){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)stop.click();}};
 g.keyUpHandler=()=>{};document.addEventListener('keydown',g.keyHandler);
}

 }
 return `<div class="v28-book-page-inner">${intro}<div class="v28-book-four">${Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=>v25BookPocket((n-1)*4+i)).join('')}</div></div>`;

 const hint=document.querySelector('.v25-book-hint');if(hint){hint.textContent='カードをタップすると拡大。ページをめくって集めよう。';hint.hidden=v25Page!==1;}

// Version display: all created instances refer to the same final file version.
const v28HtmlBase=v26Html;
v26Html=function(){return v28HtmlBase().replace(/Ver\.2\.7/g,'Ver.2.8');};
document.title=document.title.replace(/Ver\.2\.7/,'Ver.2.8');

/* Ver.2.9 | SCHOOL LUNCH COOK Ver.16.6 verified mechanics integration.
   The source's normalized love meter, normal-difficulty 4-card 6-swap memory
   and 5px-grid bubble-coverage logic are retained in this game's UI shell. */
const V29_SLC = Object.freeze({loveCycle:1850, perfectWindow:.065, goodWindow:.19,
  sinkCards:4, sinkSwaps:6, sinkPreview:1650, sinkShuffle:480, sinkPause:490,
  handRadius:122, handGrid:5, handSeconds:10, handSprayMs:85});

// The actual SLC 'loveNeedle' equation uses a triangular cycle and performance.now().
function v29LovePosition(now,started,periodMs){
 const elapsed=(now-started)/periodMs;
 const cycle=((elapsed%1)+1)%1;
 return cycle<.5?cycle*2:(1-cycle)*2;
}
function v29LoveGrade(position){
 const difference=Math.abs(position-.5);
 return difference<=V29_SLC.perfectWindow?{name:'PERFECT',points:300}:
   difference<=V29_SLC.goodWindow?{name:'GOOD',points:150}:{name:'NICE',points:30};
}
// Preserve exact source coefficients. Expose deterministic read-only QA calculations.
window.__slcIntegrationQA=Object.freeze({
  source:'SCHOOL LUNCH COOK Ver.16.6',
  lovePosition:v29LovePosition,loveGrade:v29LoveGrade,
  settings:V29_SLC,
  getState:()=>v28Game?{
    mode:v28Game.mode,active:!!v28Game.active,phase:v28Game.phase||'',
    hits:v28Game.hits||0,coverage:v28Game.percent||0,found:v28Game.found||0,
    completed:state.completed.slice(),start:v28Game.start||0
  }:null
});

v28TimingHTML=function(){
 v28Frame(`<div class="v28-mini-head v29-love-head"><span>SCHOOL LUNCH COOK ／ 愛情タイミング</span><h2>タイミングチャレンジ</h2><p>動く針をハートの真ん中で止めよう。PERFECTなら300点！</p></div>
 <div class="v28-love-panel v29-love-panel"><div class="v28-love-visual"><img src="${EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[4]}" alt="ワンタッチスライサー"><div class="v28-love-score" id="v28-love-score">READY</div></div>
 <div class="v28-love-game"><div class="v29-love-heading">♥ 真ん中でストップ！</div>
 <div class="v28-love-track v29-love-track" id="v29-love-track"><i class="v29-love-good"></i><i class="v29-love-perfect">♥ PERFECT ♥</i><i id="v28-love-needle" class="v28-love-needle"></i></div>
 <div class="v29-love-legend"><span>GOOD</span><strong>PERFECT ＋300</strong><span>GOOD</span></div>
 <div class="v28-love-actions"><button type="button" class="v28-hero-button" id="v28-love-start">はじめるよ</button><button type="button" class="v28-hero-button" id="v28-love-stop" hidden>タイミングでストップ！</button><button type="button" class="v28-hero-button" id="v28-love-complete" hidden>次へ進む</button></div>
 <p id="v28-love-message" class="v28-caption" role="status" aria-live="polite">PC：E／スペース　スマホ：ボタンをタップ</p></div></div>`);
};

v28TimingBind=function(){
 const g=v28Game={mode:'love',active:false,start:0,locked:false,raf:0,period:V29_SLC.loveCycle,grade:null,hits:0};
 const needle=$('v28-love-needle'),status=$('v28-love-score'),start=$('v28-love-start'),stop=$('v28-love-stop'),done=$('v28-love-complete'),info=$('v28-love-message');
 const pos=now=>v29LovePosition(now,g.start,g.period);
 function tick(){
  if(v28Game!==g||!g.active||g.locked)return;
  needle.style.left=(pos(performance.now())*100)+'%';
  g.raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
 }
 start.onclick=()=>{
  if(v28Game!==g||g.active||g.locked)return;
  g.active=true;g.start=performance.now();start.hidden=true;stop.hidden=false;done.hidden=true;
  status.textContent='TIMING';info.textContent='動く針が真ん中に来たらストップ！';
  g.raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
 };
 stop.onclick=()=>{
  if(v28Game!==g||!g.active||g.locked)return;
  // Use a single captured timestamp for visual position AND the score.
  const now=performance.now(),x=pos(now),grade=v29LoveGrade(x);
  g.locked=true;g.active=false;g.hits=1;g.grade=grade;
  cancelAnimationFrame(g.raf);g.raf=0;
  needle.style.left=(x*100)+'%';status.textContent=grade.name;
  info.textContent=`${grade.name}！ ＋${grade.points}点。ハートの真ん中で止めるチャレンジ完了！`;
  stop.hidden=true;done.hidden=false;
  const bar=$('v29-love-track');bar?.classList.add(grade.name==='PERFECT'?'v29-love-perfect-hit':'v29-love-hit');
  v26Sound(grade.name==='PERFECT'?'success':'tap');done.focus();
 };
 done.onclick=()=>{if(v28Game!==g||!g.locked)return;v26StopGame();winMission();};
 g.keyHandler=e=>{
  if(v28Game!==g||e.repeat||!['Space','KeyE'].includes(e.code))return;
  if(g.active&&!g.locked){e.preventDefault();stop.click();}
  else if(g.locked){e.preventDefault();done.click();}
 };
 document.addEventListener('keydown',g.keyHandler);
};

v28SinkBind=function(){
 const n=V29_SLC.sinkCards;
 const g=v28Game={mode:'sink',phase:'ready',order:[0,1,2,3],bug:0,swaps:0,hits:0,found:0,selected:1};
 const container=$('v28-sink-cards'),start=$('v28-sink-start'),next=$('v28-sink-continue'),phase=$('v28-sink-phase'),feedback=$('v28-sink-feedback');
 const cards=[];
 const bugSVG='<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true"><ellipse cx="32" cy="36" rx="8" ry="13" fill="#3b3232"/><circle cx="32" cy="20" r="6" fill="#292323"/><ellipse cx="22" cy="22" rx="9" ry="11" fill="#dcf5ff" stroke="#76b5d0" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(-25 22 22)"/><ellipse cx="42" cy="22" rx="9" ry="11" fill="#dcf5ff" stroke="#76b5d0" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(25 42 22)"/></svg>';
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
  const card=document.createElement('button');card.type='button';card.className='v28-veggie v29-sink-card';
  card.dataset.veggieId=String(i);card.setAttribute('aria-label',`${i+1}番の小松菜の葉`);
  card.innerHTML=`<img src="${V28_LEAF}" alt="小松菜の葉"><span class="v28-bug-icon">${bugSVG}</span><small>${i+1}</small>`;
  card.addEventListener('click',()=>choose(i));container.appendChild(card);cards.push(card);
 }
 function draw(animate=true){
  if(v28Game!==g)return;
  cards.forEach((card,id)=>{
   const slot=g.order.indexOf(id);
   card.style.left=(slot*25+0.7)+'%';card.style.width='23.4%';
   card.style.transitionDuration=animate?(V29_SLC.sinkShuffle*.92)+'ms':'0ms';
   card.classList.toggle('v28-has-bug',['preview','result'].includes(g.phase)&&id===g.bug);
   card.classList.toggle('v29-wash-answer',g.phase==='result'&&id===g.bug);
   card.disabled=g.phase!=='choose';card.setAttribute('aria-label',`${slot+1}番の野菜`);
  });
 }
 function shuffle(){
  if(v28Game!==g||g.phase!=='preview')return;
  g.phase='shuffle';phase.textContent='野菜が入れ替わるよ！ 0 / 6 回';draw();
  const swap=()=>{
   if(v28Game!==g||g.phase!=='shuffle')return;
   const a=Math.floor(Math.random()*n),b=(a+1+Math.floor(Math.random()*(n-1)))%n;
   [g.order[a],g.order[b]]=[g.order[b],g.order[a]];
   g.swaps++;phase.textContent=`野菜が入れ替わるよ！ ${g.swaps} / ${V29_SLC.sinkSwaps} 回`;
   draw();
   if(g.swaps<V29_SLC.sinkSwaps)v28Timer(swap,V29_SLC.sinkShuffle);
   else v28Timer(()=>{
    if(v28Game!==g)return;
    g.phase='choose';g.selected=1;phase.textContent='羽虫がいた葉を選んでね！';feedback.textContent='4枚のうち1枚をタップ。PCは←→とE／スペースでも選べるよ。';draw();
   },V29_SLC.sinkPause);
  };
  v28Timer(swap,260);
 }
 function begin(){
  if(v28Game!==g||g.phase!=='ready')return;
  g.order=[0,1,2,3];g.bug=Math.floor(Math.random()*n);g.swaps=0;g.phase='preview';
  start.hidden=true;next.hidden=true;
  phase.textContent='羽虫がいる葉を覚えよう！';feedback.textContent='目で追って、最後に選んでね。';
  draw(false);v28Timer(shuffle,V29_SLC.sinkPreview);
 }
 function choose(id){
  if(v28Game!==g||g.phase!=='choose')return;
  g.hits=1;g.found=id===g.bug?1:0;g.phase='result';draw();
  const good=!!g.found;
  phase.textContent=good?'正解！ 葉の裏までよく見たね！':'羽虫を見逃した！ 正しい葉が光っているよ。';
  feedback.textContent=good?'羽虫を発見！ カードをゲットしよう。':'学校給食では異物の見逃しに注意しよう。もう一度挑戦できるよ。';
  // SLC ends after 1 check; allow retry rather than rewarding a missed answer.
  if(good){next.hidden=false;next.focus();v26Sound('success');}
  else {start.textContent='もういちど';start.hidden=false;start.onclick=()=>{
   g.phase='ready';g.order=[0,1,2,3];draw(false);begin();
  };v26Sound('tap');}
 }
 start.onclick=begin;next.onclick=()=>{if(v28Game!==g||g.phase!=='result'||!g.found)return;v26StopGame();winMission();};
 g.keyHandler=e=>{
  if(v28Game!==g||g.phase!=='choose')return;
  if(['ArrowRight','ArrowLeft'].includes(e.code)){
   e.preventDefault();g.selected=(g.selected+(e.code==='ArrowRight'?1:n-1))%n;
   cards.forEach((c,id)=>c.classList.toggle('v29-key-selected',g.order.indexOf(id)===g.selected));
  }else if(['Space','KeyE'].includes(e.code)&&!e.repeat){e.preventDefault();choose(g.order[g.selected]);}
 };
 document.addEventListener('keydown',g.keyHandler);
 draw(false);
};

// Match the original SLC normal-difficulty hand-foam coverage settings.
// Coverage is counted only on nontransparent hand pixels sampled on a 5px grid.
v28HandBind=function(){
 const g=v28Game={mode:'hand',phase:'ready',active:false,start:0,percent:0,down:false,
   covered:new Set(),targets:[],total:0,raf:0,lastShot:0,posX:280,posY:260,keys:new Set()};
 const canvas=$('v28-hand-canvas'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),image=$('v28-hand-image'),startButton=$('v28-hand-start');
 const status=$('v28-hand-status');
 function prepare(){
  if(g.total || !image.complete || !image.naturalWidth)return;
  const off=document.createElement('canvas');off.width=image.naturalWidth;off.height=image.naturalHeight;
  const oc=off.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});oc.drawImage(image,0,0);
  let p=null;try{p=oc.getImageData(0,0,off.width,off.height).data;}catch(e){}
  for(let y=2;y<off.height;y+=V29_SLC.handGrid){for(let x=2;x<off.width;x+=V29_SLC.handGrid){
    const alpha=p?p[((y*off.width+x)*4)+3]:(((x/off.width-.5)**2)/.24+((y/off.height-.52)**2)/.25<1?255:0);
    if(alpha>175)g.targets.push({x,y,id:y*off.width+x});
  }}
  g.total=g.targets.length;
 }
 if(image.complete)prepare();else image.onload=prepare;
 function coords(e){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();return{
   x:Math.max(0,Math.min(canvas.width,(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*canvas.width)),
   y:Math.max(0,Math.min(canvas.height,(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*canvas.height))};}
 function spray(x,y){
  if(v28Game!==g||!g.active)return;
  g.posX=x;g.posY=y;prepare();if(!g.total)return;
  const radius=V29_SLC.handRadius,rs=radius*radius;
  for(const p of g.targets){const dx=p.x-x,dy=p.y-y;if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=rs)g.covered.add(p.id);}
  g.percent=Math.min(100,Math.floor(100*g.covered.size/g.total));
  $('v28-hand-percent').textContent=g.percent;
  $('v28-hand-fill').style.width=g.percent+'%';
  ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='rgba(216,249,255,.72)';ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(111,218,240,.65)';ctx.lineWidth=3;
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const a=i*2.3999,dist=i%3*13,rr=22+i%3*13;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+Math.cos(a)*dist,y+Math.sin(a)*dist,rr,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();if(i%2===0)ctx.stroke();}
  ctx.restore();
  if(g.percent>=100){g.active=false;status.textContent='泡100％！ 手洗いクリア！';v26StopGame();winMission();return;}
 }
 canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
  if(!g.active)return;e.preventDefault();g.down=true;
  try{canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch(_e){}
  const p=coords(e);spray(p.x,p.y);
 });
 canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
  if(!g.active||!g.down)return;e.preventDefault();const p=coords(e);spray(p.x,p.y);
 });
 ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'].forEach(ev=>canvas.addEventListener(ev,()=>g.down=false));
 g.keyHandler=e=>{
  if(v28Game!==g||!g.active)return;
  if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Space','KeyE'].includes(e.code)){
    e.preventDefault();g.keys.add(e.code);
  }
 };
 g.keyUpHandler=e=>g.keys.delete(e.code);
 document.addEventListener('keydown',g.keyHandler);
 document.addEventListener('keyup',g.keyUpHandler);
 function tick(now){
  if(v28Game!==g||!g.active)return;
  const seconds=(now-g.start)/1000;
  $('v28-hand-time').textContent=seconds.toFixed(1);
  let dx=Number(g.keys.has('ArrowRight'))-Number(g.keys.has('ArrowLeft')),
      dy=Number(g.keys.has('ArrowDown'))-Number(g.keys.has('ArrowUp'));
  if(dx||dy){const len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;g.posX=Math.max(0,Math.min(canvas.width,g.posX+dx/len*10));g.posY=Math.max(0,Math.min(canvas.height,g.posY+dy/len*10));}
  if((g.down||g.keys.has('Space')||g.keys.has('KeyE'))&&now-g.lastShot>=V29_SLC.handSprayMs){
   spray(g.posX,g.posY);g.lastShot=now;
  }
  if(v28Game!==g||!g.active)return;
  if(seconds>=V29_SLC.handSeconds&&g.percent<100)status.textContent='泡100％を目指して、すみずみまで洗おう！';
  g.raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
 }
 startButton.onclick=()=>{
  if(v28Game!==g||g.active)return;
  prepare();g.active=true;g.phase='shooting';g.start=performance.now();g.lastShot=0;
  startButton.hidden=true;
  status.textContent='指の間・親指・手首も、ていねいに洗おう！';
  g.raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
 };
};

/* Ver.3.25 – discovery missions: do not credit a secret until the user solves it. */
const V30_SECRETS={
  1:{name:'下処理室の かくれた役わり',intro:'土のついた野菜を、どうして別の部屋で下処理するのかな？',question:'下処理室が 分かれている 大きな理由は？',options:['土やよごれを 調理室に 持ちこまないため','野菜を かくすため','給食を 冷たくするため'],correct:0,explain:'下処理室は、土などのよごれを調理室に持ちこまないために分けています。ピーラーで皮をむいた後、じゃがいもの芽は人の手で取ります。',icon:'🥔'},
  2:{name:'昨日つくることができない！？',intro:'「前の日に全部切っておけば、朝がらくだよね？」とふーぴょん。ところが……。',question:'学校給食の 調理は いつ行うのが 原則？',options:['前の日に まとめて作る','給食を出す その日に調理する','3日前に 完成させる'],correct:1,explain:'学校給食では、原則として給食を提供する当日に調理します。生鮮食品の当日納品にも原則がありますが、例外があるため「すべて必ず当日届く」とは限りません。',icon:'🕗'},
  3:{name:'食器を守る さいごの秘密',intro:'「洗った食器は、もうそのまま使っていいのかな？」',question:'食器を洗ったあと、何をする？',options:['調理台に そのまま重ねる','必要な消毒をして 衛生的に保管する','床の上で かわかす'],correct:1,explain:'食器は洗浄後、衛生管理の手順に従って消毒し、再びよごれないように保管します。',icon:'✨'},
  4:{name:'伝説の 千人釜（せんにんがま）',intro:'「せんにんがまには、仙人が住んでいるのじゃ！」と、仙人ふーぴょんが登場！　でも、その「せんにん」は……？',question:'「千人釜」の 千人とは どんな意味？',options:['仙人が 1000人 入っている','1000人分ほどを 作れる大型の釜のこと','1000年前に 作られた釜'],correct:1,explain:'大きな給食センターなどには、1,000人分ほどを一度に調理できる大型の回転釜もあります。どの回転釜でも1,000人分作れるわけではなく、釜の大きさや料理によって量は異なります。',icon:'🍛'}
};
function openSecretChallenge(id){
 const spec=V30_SECRETS[id];if(!spec)return;
 const found=state.secrets.includes(id);
 const pic=`<div class="v31-wizard-guide"><img class="v30-secret-wizard" src="${WIZARD_FUPYON_IMAGE}" alt="魔法使い姿のふーぴょん"><span>ひみつの案内人</span></div>`;
 openModal('secret',`🔎 ひみつ ${id} ／ ${tx(spec.name)}`,`<div class="v30-secret-story">${pic}<p class="v31-wizard-quote"><strong>ふーぴょん博士</strong>${tx(spec.intro)}</p></div><div class="challengeCard"><p class="challengeQuestion">${tx(spec.question)}</p><div class="options" id="v30-secret-options">${spec.options.map((v,i)=>`<button class="option" data-secret-answer="${i}">${tx(v)}</button>`).join('')}</div><p class="feedback" id="v30-secret-feedback" aria-live="polite">${found?'もういちど ちょうせんできるよ！':'こたえを えらんでみよう！'}</p></div><div id="v30-secret-conclusion" hidden></div>`);
 const opts=$('v30-secret-options'),fb=$('v30-secret-feedback'),answer=$('v30-secret-conclusion');
 opts.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
  const chosen=Number(b.dataset.secretAnswer);
  if(chosen!==spec.correct){fb.textContent='おしい！ もう一度 考えてみよう。';v26Sound('tap');return;}
  opts.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(k=>{k.disabled=true;k.classList.toggle('used',Number(k.dataset.secretAnswer)===chosen)});
  fb.textContent='✨ 大正解！ 秘密がわかったよ！';v26Sound('success');
  answer.hidden=false;
  answer.innerHTML=`<div class="v30-secret-answer"><strong>✨ ふーぴょん博士の ひみつ解説！</strong><p>${tx(spec.explain)}</p><button id="v30-secret-claim" class="mainBtn">${found?'たんけんに もどる':'ひみつを きろくする'}</button></div>`;
  $('v30-secret-claim').onclick=()=>{
   if(!state.secrets.includes(id)){state.secrets.push(id);save();v26Sound('bonus');v26Confetti();}
   closeModal();updateHud();showToast('✨ ひみつを ひとつ かいめいしたよ！');
  };
  syncModalFooter();
 });
}


/* Ver.3.25: replace the single-page file viewer with a two-page fullscreen spread. */
let ftSpreadIndex=0;
function ftBinderPage(n){
 const line=`<div class="ft-page-topline">STAR CARD FILE ・ ${String(n).padStart(2,'0')} / 04</div>`;
 if(n===4){
  let contents;
  if(v25Completed()){
   const group=['shiro','fox','fu','piyo'].map(id=>`<img src="${ASSETS[id]}" alt="${(CHARS.find(c=>c.id===id)||{}).name||''}">`).join('');
   contents=`<h3>コンプリート！</h3><div class="ft-crew">${group}</div><p>12枚のカードを集めたよ！</p>`;
  }else contents=`<div class="ft-page-locked" aria-hidden="true">🔒</div><h3>最後のページ</h3><p>12枚ぜんぶ集めると、<br>4人の仲間が登場するよ！</p>`;
  return `<section class="ft-page" aria-label="${n}ページ"><div class="ft-page-inner">${line}<div class="ft-page-complete">${contents}</div></div></section>`;
 }
 return `<section class="ft-page" aria-label="${n}ページ"><div class="ft-page-inner">${line}<div class="ft-page-pockets">${Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=>v25BookPocket((n-1)*4+i)).join('')}</div></div></section>`;
}
function ftDrawSpread(){
 const book=$('ft-book');if(!book)return;
 const first=ftSpreadIndex*2+1;
 book.innerHTML=ftBinderPage(first)+ftBinderPage(first+1)+`<div class="ft-preview" id="ft-preview" aria-live="polite"></div>`;
 book.style.setProperty('--ft-book-bg',`url("${V28_BOOK_PAGE}")`);
 $('ft-prev').disabled=ftSpreadIndex===0;
 $('ft-next').disabled=ftSpreadIndex===1;
 $('ft-index').textContent=`${first} - ${first+1} / 4 ページ`;
 book.querySelectorAll('[data-v25-card]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>ftShowCard(Number(b.dataset.v25Card))));
}
function ftShowCard(id){
 const d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!d||!state.completed.includes(id))return;
 const layer=$('ft-preview');if(!layer)return;
 layer.innerHTML=`<div class="ft-detail" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${dName(d)}のカード"><img src="${STAR_CARD_IMAGES[id]}" alt="${dName(d)}のスターカード"><h3>${dName(d)}</h3><p>${tx(d.desc)}</p><button type="button" id="ft-detail-close">カードファイルにもどる</button></div>`;
 layer.classList.add('active');
 const btn=$('ft-detail-close');btn.onclick=()=>{layer.classList.remove('active');layer.replaceChildren();};btn.focus();
}
openGuide=function(page){
 dismissCardCapture();
 const recent=recentStarId&&state.completed.includes(recentStarId)?recentStarId:0;
 ftSpreadIndex=typeof page==='number'?(page>2?1:0):(recent>=9?1:0);
 openModal('guide',`⭐ スターカードファイル　${state.completed.length} / 12`,
 `<div class="ft-file"><div class="ft-file-top"><b>★ ${state.completed.length} / 12 枚</b><span>見開きで12枚のスターカードを集めよう！</span><b>ひみつ ${state.secrets.length} / 4</b></div><div class="ft-book-spread" id="ft-book" role="region" aria-label="見開きのカードファイル"></div><nav class="ft-file-nav" aria-label="カードファイルのページ切り替え"><button type="button" id="ft-prev">❮ 前の見開き</button><strong id="ft-index">1 - 2 / 4 ページ</strong><button type="button" id="ft-next">次の見開き ❯</button><button type="button" id="ft-return" class="ft-return">マップへ戻る</button></nav></div>`);
 $('ft-prev').onclick=()=>{if(ftSpreadIndex!==0){ftSpreadIndex=0;ftDrawSpread();}};
 $('ft-next').onclick=()=>{if(ftSpreadIndex!==1){ftSpreadIndex=1;ftDrawSpread();}};
 $('ft-return').onclick=closeModal;
 ftDrawSpread();
};

renderMap=function(){
  const layer=$('stationLayer');
  layer.innerHTML=DEVICES.map(d=>`<button class="station" data-id="${d.id}" style="left:${d.x}px;top:${d.y}px" aria-label="${d.name}を調べる"><span class="number">${String(d.id).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span class="stIcon" aria-hidden="true">${EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[d.id]?`<img class="equipment-photo" src="${EQUIPMENT_IMAGES[d.id]}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="">`:EQUIPMENT_ART[d.id]}</span><span class="stName">${d.short}</span><span class="doneMark">✓</span></button>`).join('');
  layer.querySelectorAll('.station').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();const d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===+b.dataset.id);openMission(d.id)}));
  const secretLayer=$('secretLayer');
  secretLayer.innerHTML=SECRETS.map(s=>`<button class="spark v36-secret-book" data-secret="${s.id}" style="left:${s.x}px;top:${s.y}px" aria-label="光る秘密の本をひらく"><span class="v36-secret-shell" aria-hidden="true"><img src="${V36_SECRET_BOOK_IMAGE}" alt=""></span></button>`).join('');
  secretLayer.querySelectorAll('.spark').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();const s=SECRETS.find(x=>x.id===+b.dataset.secret);if(s)openSecretChallenge(s.id)}));
  updateHud();
};

openSecretChallenge=function(id){
  const spec=V30_SECRETS[id]; if(!spec) return;
  const found=state.secrets.includes(id);
  const pic=`<div class="v31-wizard-guide"><img class="v30-secret-wizard" src="${WIZARD_FUPYON_IMAGE}" alt="魔法使い姿のふーぴょん"><span>ひみつの案内人</span></div>`;
  openModal('secret',`🔎 ひみつ ${id} ／ ${tx(spec.name)}`,
    `<div class="v36-secret-story">${pic}<div class="v36-secret-meta"><span class="v36-secret-kicker">${spec.icon} ひみつクイズ</span><p class="v31-wizard-quote"><strong>ふーぴょん博士</strong>${tx(spec.intro)}</p></div></div>`+
    `<div class="challengeCard"><p class="challengeQuestion">${tx(spec.question)}</p><div class="options" id="v30-secret-options">${spec.options.map((v,i)=>`<button class="option" data-secret-answer="${i}">${tx(v)}</button>`).join('')}</div><p class="feedback" id="v30-secret-feedback" aria-live="polite">${found?'もういちどチャレンジできるよ！':'こたえをえらんでみよう！'}</p></div><div id="v30-secret-conclusion" hidden></div>`
  );
  const opts=$('v30-secret-options'), fb=$('v30-secret-feedback'), answer=$('v30-secret-conclusion');
  opts.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    const chosen=Number(b.dataset.secretAnswer);
    if(chosen!==spec.correct){fb.textContent='おしい！ ふーぴょん博士が、もう一度考えてみてって言ってるよ。';v26Sound('tap');return;}
    opts.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(k=>{k.disabled=true;k.classList.toggle('used',Number(k.dataset.secretAnswer)===chosen)});
    fb.textContent='✨ 大正解！ ひみつの本がかがやいた！'; v26Sound('success');
    answer.hidden=false;
    answer.innerHTML=`<div class="v36-secret-bonus"><b>${spec.icon} ふーぴょん博士のひみつメモ</b><p>${tx(spec.explain)}</p><div class="modalActions"><button id="v30-secret-claim" class="mainBtn">${found?'たんけんに もどる':'ひみつを きろくする'}</button></div></div>`;
    $('v30-secret-claim').onclick=()=>{
      if(!state.secrets.includes(id)){state.secrets.push(id);save();v26Sound('bonus');v26Confetti();}
      closeModal(); updateHud(); showToast('✨ ひみつを ひとつ かいめいしたよ！');
    };
    syncModalFooter();
  });
};

let v36SpreadIndex=0;
function v36Pocket(id){
  const d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!d) return `<div class="v36-pocket v36-empty"><i>📘</i><b>COMING</b><span>カード追加予定</span></div>`;
  const got=state.completed.includes(id);
  if(!got) return `<div class="v36-pocket v36-locked"><i>⭐</i><b>No.${String(id).padStart(2,'0')}</b><span>まだみつけていないよ</span></div>`;
  return `<button type="button" class="v36-pocket v36-collected" data-v36-card="${id}" aria-label="${dName(d)}のカードを大きく表示">${starCardArt(d)}</button>`;
}
function v36SpreadCards(index){
  const start=index*6+1;
  const left=[start,start+1,start+2].map(v36Pocket).join('');
  const right=[start+3,start+4,start+5].map(v36Pocket).join('');
  return `<div class="v36-book-tag">FUJINOE STAR CARD FILE</div>${state.completed.length===12?'<div class="v36-complete-ribbon">COMPLETE!</div>':''}<section class="v36-pageArea left">${left}</section><section class="v36-pageArea right">${right}</section><div class="v36-spread-index">見開き ${index+1} / 2</div><div class="v36-preview" id="v36-preview" aria-live="polite"></div>`;
}
function v36RenderGuide(){
  const book=$('v36-book'); if(!book) return;
  book.style.setProperty('--v36-book-bg',`url("${V36_CARD_SPREAD_BG}")`);
  book.innerHTML=v36SpreadCards(v36SpreadIndex);
  $('v36-prev').disabled=v36SpreadIndex===0;
  $('v36-next').disabled=v36SpreadIndex===1;
  $('v36-index').textContent=`${v36SpreadIndex+1} / 2 みひらき`;
  book.querySelectorAll('[data-v36-card]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>v36ShowCard(Number(btn.dataset.v36Card))));
}
function v36ShowCard(id){
  const d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!d||!state.completed.includes(id)) return;
  const layer=$('v36-preview'); if(!layer) return;
  layer.innerHTML=`<div class="v36-preview-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${dName(d)}のカード"><img src="${STAR_CARD_IMAGES[id]}" alt="${dName(d)}のスターカード"><h3>${dName(d)}</h3><p>${tx(d.desc)}</p><button type="button" id="v36-close-card">カードファイルにもどる</button></div>`;
  layer.classList.add('active');
  const close=$('v36-close-card');
  close.onclick=()=>{layer.classList.remove('active');layer.replaceChildren();};
  close.focus();
}
openGuide=function(){
  dismissCardCapture();
  const recent=recentStarId&&state.completed.includes(recentStarId)?recentStarId:0;
  v36SpreadIndex=recent>=7?1:0;
  const topHint=state.completed.length===12?'12枚コンプリート！ カードをタップして大きく見よう':'6枚ずつの見開きファイル！ カードをタップすると拡大するよ';
  openModal('guide',`⭐ スターカードファイル　${state.completed.length} / 12`,
    `<div class="v36-guide-shell"><div class="v36-guide-top"><b>★ ${state.completed.length} / 12</b><span>${topHint}</span><b>✨ ひみつ ${state.secrets.length} / 4</b></div><div class="v36-book-stage"><div class="v36-book-spread" id="v36-book" role="region" aria-label="左右2ページのカードファイル見開き"></div></div><div class="v36-guide-nav"><button type="button" id="v36-prev">❮ 前の見開き</button><button type="button" id="v36-next">次の見開き ❯</button><strong id="v36-index">1 / 2 みひらき</strong><button type="button" class="v36-return" id="v36-return">マップへ戻る</button></div></div>`
  );
  $('v36-prev').onclick=()=>{if(v36SpreadIndex>0){v36SpreadIndex--;v36RenderGuide();}};
  $('v36-next').onclick=()=>{if(v36SpreadIndex<1){v36SpreadIndex++;v36RenderGuide();}};
  $('v36-return').onclick=closeModal;
  v36RenderGuide();
};

/* Ver.3.25 overrides: secret book positions/style + update-check flow */
const APP_VERSION='3.25';
window.APP_VERSION=APP_VERSION;
(function(){
  const prep=V26_ROOMS.find(r=>r.key==='prep');
  const storage=V26_ROOMS.find(r=>r.key==='storage');
  const wash=V26_ROOMS.find(r=>r.key==='wash');
  const clean=V26_ROOMS.find(r=>r.key==='clean');
  const cook=V26_ROOMS.find(r=>r.key==='cook');
  if(prep) prep.secret=0;
  if(storage) storage.secret=2;
  if(wash) wash.secret=1;
  if(clean) clean.secret=3;
  if(cook) cook.secret=4;
})();
function v37SecretButton(secretId){
  if(!secretId) return '';
  return `<button type="button" class="v26-secret ${state.secrets.includes(secretId)?'found':''}" data-v26-secret="${secretId}" aria-label="秘密の本をひらく"><span class="v37-secret-shell" aria-hidden="true"><img src="${V31_SECRET_BOOK_IMAGE}" alt=""></span>${state.secrets.includes(secretId)?'<span class="v37-secret-done" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>':''}</button>`;
}
v26Room=function(room){
  return `<section class="v26-room v26-${room.style}" aria-label="${v26E(room.name)}"><div class="v26-room-head"><h2>${v26E(v26Kanji(room.name,tx(room.name)))}</h2><small>${v26E(v26Kanji(room.kind,tx(room.kind)))}</small></div><div class="v26-devices v26-device-count-${room.ids.length}">${room.ids.map(v26Device).join('')}</div>${v37SecretButton(room.secret||0)}</section>`;
};
function v37CompareVersion(a,b){
  const pa=String(a||'').split('.').map(v=>parseInt(v,10)||0), pb=String(b||'').split('.').map(v=>parseInt(v,10)||0);
  for(let i=0;i<Math.max(pa.length,pb.length);i++){ const da=pa[i]||0, db=pb[i]||0; if(da>db) return 1; if(da<db) return -1; }
  return 0;
}
function v37ExtractVersion(text){
  const patterns=[/window\.APP_VERSION\s*=\s*['"]([0-9.]+)['"]/,/const\s+APP_VERSION\s*=\s*['"]([0-9.]+)['"]/,/buildVersion">\s*Ver\.([0-9.]+)/,/Ver\.([0-9.]+)/];
  for(const re of patterns){ const m=String(text||'').match(re); if(m&&m[1]) return m[1]; }
  return '';
}
function v37EnsureUpdateNotice(){
  let box=$('updateNotice');
  if(box) return box;
  box=document.createElement('div');
  box.id='updateNotice';
  box.className='updateNotice';
  box.innerHTML=`<div class="updateNoticeText"><strong id="updateNoticeTitle">新しいバージョンがあります</strong><span id="updateNoticeBody">更新すると最新の内容で遊べます。</span></div><div class="updateNoticeActions"><button type="button" class="ghost" id="updateNoticeLater">あとで</button><button type="button" class="primary" id="updateNoticeReload">再読み込み</button></div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(box);
  $('updateNoticeLater').addEventListener('click',()=>box.classList.remove('show'));
  $('updateNoticeReload').addEventListener('click',()=>v37ReloadToLatest());
  return box;
}
function v37ShowUpdateNotice(remote){
  const box=v37EnsureUpdateNotice();
  const title=$('updateNoticeTitle'), body=$('updateNoticeBody');
  if(title) title.textContent=`新しいバージョン（Ver.${remote}）があります`;
  if(body) body.textContent=`現在は Ver.${APP_VERSION} です。ボタンを押すと最新の公開版へ再読み込みします。`;
  box.classList.add('show');
}
function v37HideUpdateNotice(){ const box=$('updateNotice'); if(box) box.classList.remove('show'); }
async function v37ReloadToLatest(){return fkiReloadLatest('manual');}
async function v37CheckPublishedVersion(manual=false){return fkiCheckLatest({manual,automatic:!!manual,reason:'manual'});}
function v37InstallUpdateCheckButton(){
  const nav=document.querySelector('.topLinks');
  if(!nav || nav.querySelector('.updateCheckBtn')) return;
  const btn=document.createElement('button');
  btn.type='button';
  btn.className='tinyButton updateCheckBtn';
  btn.textContent='更新確認';
  btn.addEventListener('click',()=>v37CheckPublishedVersion(true));
  nav.appendChild(btn);
}
function v37BootUpdateFlow(){v37EnsureUpdateNotice();v37InstallUpdateCheckButton();}
document.querySelectorAll('.buildVersion').forEach(el=>el.textContent='Ver.3.25');
if(document.querySelector('.v26-stage')){ v26RefreshUI(); }
v37BootUpdateFlow();


/* Ver.3.25 mobile card-file refresh */
const V39_CARD_PAGE_BG = 'data:image/webp;base64,';
(function(){
  const style=document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent=`
  #modalWrap.starMode .modal{width:min(1120px,99vw)!important;height:min(840px,96dvh)!important;max-height:96dvh!important}
  #modalWrap.starMode .modalBody{padding:4px!important}
  .v36-guide-shell{height:100%;gap:8px!important}
  .v36-guide-top{padding:0 6px!important}
  .v36-book-stage{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:0;padding:0!important}
  .v36-book-spread{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
  .v36-book-spread.mobilePage{width:min(100vw,640px)!important;height:min(calc(100dvh - 168px),920px)!important;aspect-ratio:2 / 3!important;background-image:var(--v36-book-bg)!important;background-size:100% 100%!important;background-position:center center!important;background-repeat:no-repeat!important;border-radius:18px!important;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(19,55,89,.18)!important}
  .v36-book-spread.mobilePage .v39-page-tag{position:absolute;left:50%;top:4.8%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:clamp(11px,2.2vw,15px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#1a567c;background:rgba(255,255,255,.75);padding:4px 12px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(21,69,101,.12)}
  .v36-book-spread.mobilePage .v39-page-cards{position:absolute;left:9.2%;right:9.2%;top:10.5%;bottom:11.3%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(10px,2.2vw,17px)}
  .v36-book-spread.mobilePage .v36-pocket{padding:7px!important;border-radius:18px!important}
  .v36-book-spread.mobilePage .v36-pocket.v36-locked, .v36-book-spread.mobilePage .v36-pocket.v36-empty{padding:10px 5px!important}
  .v36-book-spread.mobilePage .v36-pocket.v36-locked b, .v36-book-spread.mobilePage .v36-pocket.v36-empty b{font-size:clamp(13px,2.9vw,19px)!important}
  .v36-book-spread.mobilePage .v39-page-index{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:5.7%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:5px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);color:#2d5f80;font-size:clamp(11px,2.6vw,15px);font-weight:1000;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(21,69,101,.15)}
  .v36-book-spread.mobilePage .v36-preview-card{width:min(94vw,430px)!important;padding:16px 14px 14px!important}
  .v36-book-spread.mobilePage .v36-preview-card img{max-width:min(74vw,270px)!important}
  .v36-guide-nav{gap:8px!important}
  .v36-guide-nav button{min-height:42px!important}
  .v36-preview-card p{white-space:normal!important}
  .cardCaptureOverlay.visible{display:flex!important;pointer-events:auto!important}
  .cardCaptureOverlay.ready{cursor:pointer}
  .cardCaptureRead{max-width:min(92vw,520px);padding:10px 14px 12px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);border:2px solid rgba(255,236,170,.95);box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(27,31,46,.22);text-align:center;color:#3c3c46;opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px) scale(.95)}
  .cardCaptureRead h3{margin:0 0 5px;font-size:clamp(18px,4.1vw,27px);line-height:1.25;color:#1b597f}
  .cardCaptureRead p{margin:0;font-size:clamp(12px,2.5vw,16px);line-height:1.7}
  .cardCaptureRead small{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:clamp(11px,2.4vw,15px);font-weight:1000;color:#a55d1e}
  .cardCaptureOverlay.animate .cardCaptureRead{animation:cardLabelV20 .4s .38s ease forwards}
  .cardCaptureOverlay.collected .cardCaptureRead{animation:cardLabelV20 .25s reverse forwards}
  @media(max-width:760px){
    #modalWrap.starMode .modal{width:100vw!important;height:97dvh!important;max-height:97dvh!important;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0!important}
    #modalWrap.starMode .modalTop{padding:6px 12px!important;min-height:44px!important}
    #modalWrap.starMode .modalBody{padding:2px!important}
    .v36-guide-shell{gap:6px!important}
    .v36-guide-top{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr!important;text-align:center!important;gap:3px!important}
    .v36-guide-top b{font-size:13px!important}
    .v36-guide-top span{font-size:11px!important;line-height:1.35!important}
    .v36-guide-nav{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important;gap:6px!important;width:100%}
    .v36-guide-nav strong{grid-column:1 / -1;order:-1;text-align:center;font-size:12px!important}
    .v36-guide-nav .v36-return{grid-column:1 / -1}
    .v36-guide-nav button{font-size:11px!important;padding:8px 10px!important;min-height:38px!important}
    .cardCaptureFront{max-width:74vw!important;height:min(44dvh,360px)!important}
    .cardCaptureRead{max-width:92vw}
  }
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(style);

  function v39IsPhone(){ return window.matchMedia('(max-width: 760px)').matches; }
  function v39CloseCapture(){
    clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer); clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer2);
    const host=$('cardCaptureOverlay');
    if(!host) return;
    host.classList.remove('visible','animate','collected','ready');
    host.onclick=null;
    host.replaceChildren();
    host.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  }
  dismissCardCapture=v39CloseCapture;
  launchCardCapture=function(d){
    const host=$('cardCaptureOverlay'); if(!host) return;
    host.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
    host.innerHTML=`<div class="cardCaptureSpark">✦　★　✧</div><div class="cardCaptureFront">${starCardArt(d)}</div><div class="cardCaptureLabel">★ スターカード GET！</div><div class="cardCaptureRead"><h3>${dName(d)}</h3><p>${tx(d.desc)}</p><small>タップして カードファイルに しゅうのう</small></div><div class="cardCaptureFolder"><b>📕</b><span>カードを よんだら 収納できるよ！</span></div>`;
    host.classList.remove('collected','ready');
    host.classList.add('visible'); void host.offsetWidth;
    requestAnimationFrame(()=>host.classList.add('animate'));
    clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer); clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer2);
    window._cardEffectTimer=setTimeout(()=>host.classList.add('ready'),720);
    window._cardEffectTimer2=setTimeout(()=>{ if(host.classList.contains('visible') && !host.classList.contains('collected')) host.classList.add('ready'); }, 1300);
    host.onclick=()=>{
      if(!host.classList.contains('ready')) return;
      if(!host.classList.contains('collected')){
        host.classList.add('collected');
        clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer2);
        window._cardEffectTimer2=setTimeout(v39CloseCapture,760);
      }else{
        v39CloseCapture();
      }
    };
  };

  function v39MobilePage(index){
    const start=index*6+1;
    const cards=Array.from({length:6},(_,i)=>v36Pocket(start+i)).join('');
    return `<div class="v39-page-tag">FUJINOE STAR CARD FILE</div>${state.completed.length===12?'<div class="v36-complete-ribbon">COMPLETE!</div>':''}<section class="v39-page-cards">${cards}</section><div class="v39-page-index">PAGE ${index+1} / 2</div><div class="v36-preview" id="v36-preview" aria-live="polite"></div>`;
  }

  const v39DesktopSpread = function(index){
    const start=index*6+1;
    const left=[start,start+1,start+2].map(v36Pocket).join('');
    const right=[start+3,start+4,start+5].map(v36Pocket).join('');
    return `<div class="v36-book-tag">FUJINOE STAR CARD FILE</div>${state.completed.length===12?'<div class="v36-complete-ribbon">COMPLETE!</div>':''}<section class="v36-pageArea left">${left}</section><section class="v36-pageArea right">${right}</section><div class="v36-spread-index">見開き ${index+1} / 2</div><div class="v36-preview" id="v36-preview" aria-live="polite"></div>`;
  };

  v36SpreadCards=function(index){
    return v39IsPhone() ? v39MobilePage(index) : v39DesktopSpread(index);
  };

  v36RenderGuide=function(){
    const book=$('v36-book'); if(!book) return;
    const mobile=v39IsPhone();
    book.classList.toggle('mobilePage', mobile);
    book.classList.toggle('desktopSpread', !mobile);
    book.style.setProperty('--v36-book-bg',`url("${mobile ? V39_CARD_PAGE_BG : V36_CARD_SPREAD_BG}")`);
    book.innerHTML=v36SpreadCards(v36SpreadIndex);
    $('v36-prev').disabled=v36SpreadIndex===0;
    $('v36-next').disabled=v36SpreadIndex===1;
    $('v36-index').textContent=mobile ? `${v36SpreadIndex+1} / 2 ページ` : `${v36SpreadIndex+1} / 2 みひらき`;
    book.querySelectorAll('[data-v36-card]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>v36ShowCard(Number(btn.dataset.v36Card))));
  };

  openGuide=function(){
    dismissCardCapture();
    const recent=recentStarId&&state.completed.includes(recentStarId)?recentStarId:0;
    v36SpreadIndex=recent>=7?1:0;
    const mobile=v39IsPhone();
    const topHint=mobile
      ? 'スマホでは1ページに6枚。カードをタップすると大きく読めるよ'
      : (state.completed.length===12?'12枚コンプリート！ カードをタップして大きく見よう':'6枚ずつの見開きファイル！ カードをタップすると拡大するよ');
    openModal('guide',`⭐ スターカードファイル　${state.completed.length} / 12`,
      `<div class="v36-guide-shell"><div class="v36-guide-top"><b>★ ${state.completed.length} / 12</b><span>${topHint}</span><b>✨ ひみつ ${state.secrets.length} / 4</b></div><div class="v36-book-stage"><div class="v36-book-spread" id="v36-book" role="region" aria-label="${mobile?'スマホ用カードファイル':'左右2ページのカードファイル見開き'}"></div></div><div class="v36-guide-nav"><button type="button" id="v36-prev">❮ 前へ</button><button type="button" id="v36-next">次へ ❯</button><strong id="v36-index">1 / 2</strong><button type="button" class="v36-return" id="v36-return">マップへ戻る</button></div></div>`
    );
    $('v36-prev').onclick=()=>{if(v36SpreadIndex>0){v36SpreadIndex--;v36RenderGuide();}};
    $('v36-next').onclick=()=>{if(v36SpreadIndex<1){v36SpreadIndex++;v36RenderGuide();}};
    $('v36-return').onclick=closeModal;
    v36RenderGuide();
  };

  window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{
    const wrap=$('modalWrap');
    if(wrap && wrap.classList.contains('starMode') && $('v36-book')) v36RenderGuide();
  });
})();



/* Ver.3.25 -- one uncut open book + cards + 10 second collect + book placement */
const V310_OPEN_BOOK = 'data:image/webp;base64,
